_title: Castle Guardians – Pixel Art Tower Defense Game
_description: Arm your castle with towers, stop the enemy waves and defeat the bosses. 250 levels, 5 tower types, 4 heroes, 75 languages. A free tower defense game.
_keywords: castle guardians, tower defense game, pixel art game, strategy game, castle defense
hero_lead: Arm your castle with towers, stop the enemy waves and defend your kingdom against the bosses. 250 levels, 5 tower types, 4 heroes and 75 languages make up this pixel-art tower defense saga.
towers_desc: Five tower types, four heroes and soldiers who climb through the ranks are waiting to build your defense.
t_1_d: Archer, mage, cannon, barracks and frost towers; each one levels up 3 times and offers 2 specializations.
t_2_d: Power up your heroes with sword, armor and amulet upgrades, and let them lead the battlefield.
t_3_d: Soldiers that march out of the barracks tower get promoted through 7 ranks as they fight.
t_4_d: Keep spells on hand to turn the tide of battle at critical moments.
feat_desc: Deep strategy from simple taps: build, upgrade, defend.
f_1_d: 250 levels across 10 regions in total; the difficulty rises steadily as you progress.
f_2_t: Keep your gold even if you lose
f_2_d: Losing a level doesn't cost you the gold you earned — spend it on permanent upgrades.
f_3_d: Face powerful bosses head-on at the end of every region.
f_4_d: Log in every day and collect free gold to spend on upgrades.
f_5_d: The interface is available in 75 languages, so players everywhere get the same experience.
screens_desc: Sample screens from the towers, the heroes and the boss battles.
cta_desc: Castle Guardians is free. Download it now and build your towers.
